findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff-graft/SKILL.md::hardcoded priority literals at two graft capture sites bypass the shared cli
findings.title: hardcoded priority literals at two graft capture sites bypass the shared CLI
findings.action: shell faff discovered-scope-priority at both sites instead of inlining the answer
findings.disposition_rationale: Valid: the CI-triage and post-merge-verification bullets inlined priority:"high" instead of pointing at the shared lookup, reintroducing the drift the lookup exists to prevent. Reworded both to point at the capture procedure / shell the CLI rather than restating the answer; also had to rephrase once more to avoid an unrelated inline-enum-restatement lint false-positive (the literal token "none" coincided with the ci-triage contract's unrelated fault_domain_source enum within the linter's 2-line window).

occurrences.title: hardcoded priority literals at two graft capture sites bypass the shared CLI

findings.finding_id: test/faff-1399-discovered-scope-priority.test.mjs::vacuous static-text test assertion for tidy's absent-priority fallback
findings.title: vacuous static-text test assertion for tidy's absent-priority fallback
findings.action: match tidy's actual new wiring text instead of pre-existing, unrelated text
findings.disposition_rationale: Valid: the assertion matched /chain-gap/i, text that predates this PR and can never fail from a regression. Replaced with a dedicated test asserting tidy's actual new --source chain-gap call and its own CLI-failure-at-filing-time fallback line (tidy computes priority fresh per chain-gap item and never reads a stored absent value, so the beep-boop/graft-style absent-priority assertion doesn't apply to it structurally).

occurrences.title: vacuous static-text test assertion for tidy's absent-priority fallback
